name: The Sin of Falling for You
source:
With a touch that brings pain, an inborn suffering, the demon is condemned by the skies. Their heart is unworthy of the angel's care.

The angel reaches for their one beloved, yet to embrace the demon is to sentence themselves to the same fall.

Is love worth the shared fall?

[From [url=https://aiainaine.itch.io/the-sin-of-falling-for-you]itch.io[/url]]
